title: Round 5: less high-frequency sharpness
about: Round 5 (10-21). In round 4 you kept the lower raking light with the old smoothing (L02) and found a bit much high-frequency sharpness in most versions. L02 is now both built-in looks (L01, F01 here). This round goes softer from there, one step at a time: 02 the raking light's fine texture lower (0.15 → 0.05), 03 the relief's fine detail back to the favourite's own (the round 2 'crisper texture' ×1.4 taken out), 04 the raking light smoothed a little more (detail 0.02 → 0.03), 05 all three. Hold the picture to flip to 01 (for 02–05) or to the photo (for 01). Rendered without the guard, like rounds 3 and 4.
